d: Ukraine has taken its war with Russia far beyond the front lines, striking two Russian vessels at Libya's Benghazi port. Kyiv says the attack disrupted Russian military operations. But the timing raises a bigger question. With the Trump administration pushing for a peace deal and Ukraine facing pressure to give up territory in Donbas, is Zelensky trying to strengthen his hand? Ukraine can strike Russian targets thousands of kilometres away, but it still depends heavily on American weapons to defend its own cities. How long can Kyiv keep fighting on two fronts?
